| Ajay Kumar | Ambassador of India to Iraq (next) |

| ACC overseas appointments | 10 fresh + 1 extension (ADB, IMF, SAARC, Tokyo, Rome, ICAO, World Bank posts) — incl. Rahul Jain (Sr Adviser to ED-India, IMF), Baldeo Purushartha (Sr Adviser to ED, ADB), Satyajit Mohanty (India's Rep, ICAO Council) |
| International | Todd Blanche (US AG) · Abelardo de la Espriella (Colombia President) · András Baka (Hungary President) · N. Chandrasekaran (stepping down as Tata Sons Chairman on term end) |
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Varsha Aglawe = 1st woman DG of GSI (176-yr-old org); note the DGNO/DCNS sequence (Pramod moved DGNO→DCNS, Chadha became new DGNO) as a cross-week trap.
